{
  "candidate": "cand_0001",
  "headline": "Code guards (DOB autocorrect, payment validation/limits, cancel & certificate policy predicates, leg-date + route checks) plus 3 new compute tools (price ranking, change-cost quote, flight durations)",
  "clusters": [
    {"id": "A", "name": "Fabricated holder DOB", "detail": "agent invents dob instead of copying profile dob", "tasks": ["8", "20", "23", "35"], "scope": "WIDESPREAD", "latent": false, "tag": "BEHAVIORAL"},
    {"id": "B", "name": "Invented payment ids / multiple certificates", "detail": "ids built from last-4 or docstring examples; >1 certificate", "tasks": ["20", "23", "35", "44"], "scope": "WIDESPREAD", "latent": false, "tag": "BEHAVIORAL"},
    {"id": "C", "name": "Hand-computed prices/ranking wrong", "detail": "cheapest/2nd cheapest and change cost miscomputed; cabin change reprices all legs", "tasks": ["10", "23", "35", "44"], "scope": "WIDESPREAD", "latent": false, "tag": "CAPABILITY-GAP"},
    {"id": "D", "name": "Cancelling ineligible reservations", "detail": "agent caves to insistence; cancels economy/no-insurance/>24h", "tasks": ["35", "44"], "scope": "BOUNDED", "latent": false, "tag": "BEHAVIORAL"},
    {"id": "E", "name": "No flight durations", "detail": "no tool exposes scheduled times -> transfer", "tasks": ["44"], "scope": "BOUNDED", "latent": false, "tag": "CAPABILITY-GAP"},
    {"id": "F", "name": "Refuses split into separate reservations", "detail": "invented prohibition", "tasks": ["23"], "scope": "BOUNDED", "latent": false, "tag": "KNOWLEDGE"},
    {"id": "G", "name": "Wrong connecting-leg date", "detail": "+1 arrival misread", "tasks": ["20"], "scope": "BOUNDED", "latent": false, "tag": "BEHAVIORAL"},
    {"id": "H", "name": "Scrambled unchanged legs on update", "detail": "return legs replaced", "tasks": ["10"], "scope": "BOUNDED", "latent": false, "tag": "BEHAVIORAL"},
    {"id": "I", "name": "Unwarranted certificate", "detail": "goodwill certificate without cancelled/delayed flight", "tasks": ["35"], "scope": "BOUNDED", "latent": false, "tag": "BEHAVIORAL"},
    {"id": "J", "name": "total_baggages = allowance", "detail": "sets free allowance as bag count", "tasks": ["35"], "scope": "BOUNDED", "latent": false, "tag": "KNOWLEDGE"}
  ],
  "edits": [
    {"id": "E1", "title": "book_reservation: DOB autocorrect, payment id/limit/balance guards, leg-date fix, split + baggage docs", "files": ["my_skill/scripts/book_reservation.py"], "lever": "BEHAVIORAL", "clusters": ["A", "B", "F", "G", "J"], "blast_radius": "BOUNDED", "verified": "fires on trace args of 8/20; all 10 gold book calls unaltered"},
    {"id": "E2", "title": "cancel_reservation: policy eligibility predicate guard", "files": ["my_skill/scripts/cancel_reservation.py"], "lever": "BEHAVIORAL", "clusters": ["D"], "blast_radius": "BOUNDED", "verified": "refuses M20IZO; all 11 gold cancels pass"},
    {"id": "E3", "title": "send_certificate: cancelled/delayed + amount predicate guard", "files": ["my_skill/scripts/send_certificate.py"], "lever": "BEHAVIORAL", "clusters": ["I"], "blast_radius": "BOUNDED", "verified": "refuses 35 t1 call; no gold send_certificate exists"},
    {"id": "E4", "title": "update_reservation_flights: payment + route continuity guards, quote-first doc", "files": ["my_skill/scripts/update_reservation_flights.py"], "lever": "BEHAVIORAL", "clusters": ["B", "H", "C"], "blast_radius": "BOUNDED", "verified": "fires on 10 t2 / 44 t3; all 20 gold calls pass"},
    {"id": "E5", "title": "NEW calculate_flight_change_cost", "files": ["my_skill/scripts/calculate_flight_change_cost.py"], "lever": "CAPABILITY-GAP", "clusters": ["C"], "blast_radius": "BOUNDED", "verified": "equals env charge on 5 reservations"},
    {"id": "E6", "title": "NEW search_itineraries_by_price", "files": ["my_skill/scripts/search_itineraries_by_price.py"], "lever": "CAPABILITY-GAP", "clusters": ["C"], "blast_radius": "BOUNDED", "verified": "rank matches gold for 20, 23, 35"},
    {"id": "E7", "title": "NEW get_reservation_flight_times", "files": ["my_skill/scripts/get_reservation_flight_times.py"], "lever": "CAPABILITY-GAP", "clusters": ["E"], "blast_radius": "BOUNDED", "verified": "durations for all 44 reservations incl. landed flights"},
    {"id": "E8", "title": "Docstring pointers + removal of copyable example ids", "files": ["my_skill/scripts/search_direct_flight.py", "my_skill/scripts/search_onestop_flight.py", "my_skill/scripts/get_reservation_details.py", "my_skill/scripts/update_reservation_baggages.py"], "lever": "KNOWLEDGE", "clusters": ["B", "C", "E"], "blast_radius": "BOUNDED", "verified": "text check"}
  ],
  "skipped": [
    {"title": "42 t1 cancelled others' reservation", "reason": "no general predicate without blocking legit cancels"},
    {"title": "insurance-reason cancel check in code", "reason": "frozen signature has no reason arg; docstring only"},
    {"title": "transfer guard", "reason": "gold task 13 needs transfer on request; unbounded"}
  ],
  "techniques": ["in-body normalization", "validation guards with enriched errors", "discriminating-predicate guards", "new compute tools", "replay of all gold actions through wrappers as blast-radius check"]
}
